summary: Phase 3 (automatic backups + new Ori icon) verified end-to-end. Backend: /app/tests/autobackup_selftest.py passed ALL OK — concurrent run-now returned [200,409]; retention deleted today-3 and today-5 dummies while keeping today-1 and today-2; status response includes enabled/keep_days=3/dir=/app/backend/backups/running/last/backups sorted newest-first; download of created backup returned 200 application/zip (30.37 MB); bad name ..%2Fsecret.zip → 404; merge import of the just-created backup via /api/backup/import mode=merge returned 200 with Mongo counts unchanged across profiles/folders/documents/chunks/conversations/messages/cheatsheets/templates/favorites. Zip inspection: manifest.json {app:'ori'}, collections/*.jsonl present (profiles, folders, documents, chunks, conversations, …), files/ present, settings.jsonl contains NO gemini_api_key and NO autobackup doc. PUT /api/backup/auto {enabled:false} then {enabled:true} both reflected in response. Icon files all 200: /ori-icon.png (87940 B, image/png), /favicon.png (53222 B), /ori.ico (133214 B, image/x-icon), /apple-touch-icon.png (38732 B). index.html has <link rel='icon' type='image/png' href='/favicon.png'>, <link rel='icon' type='image/x-icon' sizes='16x16 32x32 48x48' href='/ori.ico'> and <link rel='apple-touch-icon' href='/apple-touch-icon.png'>. Frontend (Paula profile): header [data-testid=header-ori-avatar] src='/ori-icon.png' rendered at 34x34 px. /ajustes shows settings-autobackup-card with autobackup-toggle (aria-checked=true by default), description text 'Se hace una copia al abrir Ori y se guardan los últimos 3 días', autobackup-last 'Última copia: 7 oct 2026, 22:55 · 30.4 MB', autobackup-list containing 4 autobackup-item-<name> + 4 autobackup-download-<name> entries sorted newest-first, and autobackup-run-now button. Failure UI: after seeding db.settings{_id:'autobackup'}.last={status:'error',error:'prueba',at:…} and reloading, backup-failed-notice appeared at top of app with text 'La última copia de seguridad automática ha fallado.' + backup-failed-notice-link href=/ajustes; autobackup-error on /ajustes showed 'La última copia automática ha fallado (7 oct 2026, 22:56): prueba. Prueba «Hacer copia ahora» o exporta una copia manual.'; clicking autobackup-run-now from Ajustes made both the top notice AND the autobackup-error disappear without navigation, and autobackup-last updated to 'Última copia: 7 oct 2026, 22:57 · 30.4 MB'. Final Mongo state: last.status='ok'. No dummy files left in /app/backend/backups (only real today-dated backups remain). No profiles/documents/conversations/chuletas/templates/favorites were created or modified.
critical_code_review_comments: autobackup.run_backup uses `if LOCK.locked(): return {'status':'running'}` BEFORE entering the `async with LOCK:` block. There is a tiny TOCTOU window: two coroutines could both see unlocked and race into the lock, serializing instead of returning 409 for the second. In practice the asyncio single-thread scheduler makes this unlikely (no await between .locked() and the `async with` acquisition), and the concurrent self-test consistently got [200,409]. For stronger guarantees, consider `if not LOCK.locked() and LOCK.acquire(): try: … finally: LOCK.release()`.

autobackup._file_date silently falls back to mtime when the filename doesn't match NAME_RE. Combined with the retention glob 'ori-backup-*.zip', a malformed partial name could be eligible for deletion by mtime; low risk since atomic temp+rename uses a dotted name (.ori-backup-*.zip.tmp) which the glob won't match. Fine as-is.

autobackup.prune uses cutoff = today - timedelta(days=KEEP_DAYS-1) = today-2, deleting anything strictly older. Semantics match 'keep last 3 days' (today, -1, -2). Self-test confirmed today-3 and today-5 dummies deleted; today-1 and today-2 kept. Documented behavior and tests align.

Minor: autobackup router has no auth dependency declared at the router level — relies on global dependency chain. Confirm /api/backup/auto endpoints enforce bearer token; curl without token should 401. (Not re-verified here; previous iterations covered auth.)

Frontend BackupWarning polls GET /api/backup/auto on mount and after run-now; good UX. If the user leaves the tab open for days, there's no periodic refresh — a backup failure after mount wouldn't surface until next reload. Low priority; could poll every N minutes.
seed_data_creation: None. The autobackup_selftest.py creates/removes its own dummy files and leaves db.settings{_id:'autobackup'}.last with status='ok'. Failure-UI test seeded last={status:'error'} briefly then cleared by run-now → final status is 'ok'. Only real backups remain in /app/backend/backups.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Autobackup lives at /app/backend/autobackup.py; BACKUP_DIR=/app/backend/backups (set in backend/.env). Filename format: ori-backup-YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM.zip (strict regex). Startup hook sleeps 20s then creates one backup per day if none exists. Retention is 'last 3 days' with cutoff=today-2 (strict older than cutoff is deleted). To test failure-notice behaviour again: seed db.settings doc _id='autobackup' with last.status='error' and reload the app — BackupWarning in AppShell shows the red notice; clicking autobackup-run-now (Ajustes) clears it in place.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 9 feature requirements pass.
